description: Open-web first pass is not the manual LexisNexis major-publications workflow. Search silence does not establish protest=0.
required_followup: Reconcile accessible periodical archives and approved coverage protocol before absence coding.

description: Spanish, French, English and limited Portuguese discovery were used. No validated Fang, Bubi, Ndowe or Fa d’Ambô search vocabulary or native-language archive review.
required_followup: Obtain linguistic review and local-language archives; do not equate Spanish coverage with all local reporting.

description: Malabo and Bata dominate indexed discoveries. Bioko, Río Muni, Ebebiyín, Mongomo, Evinayong and Annobón terms were searched but rural/remote coverage remains sparse.
required_followup: Review district-level and island media with event-specific dates.

description: Labor, education, health, transport, market women, utilities, land, religion and rights terms were searched; no systematic sector archive was available.
required_followup: Check labor/sector archives and contemporary local reports without interpreting absence of indexed hits as no action.

description: Several CI pages and historical news pages returned web cache misses; ordinary normal-TLS HTTPS recovered selected paragraphs. RFI domain search was explicitly blocked by robots.
required_followup: Keep recovered body versus partial/unread scopes distinct; respect explicit denials. Seek public alternative original reporting.

description: CI article and CI category copies are a single party origin. Anonymous plot allegations and six-stars attribution lack independent corroboration.
required_followup: Recover original letter and independently dated contemporary accounts; do not count republication as confirmation.

description: January 19 is a statement date. The anonymous six-stars proposal has no agreed date or proven executed physical onset.
required_followup: Find actual execution reporting before assigning a start date or monthly ownership.

description: No crowd is reported for six-stars proposal. Shirts, cards, membership and cumulative detentions cannot establish 50 actual participants.
required_followup: Obtain contemporaneous gathering-specific qualitative or numeric crowd evidence.

description: General repression, earlier incidents, forecast threats and a separate January 29 individual arrest do not identify responses to the six-stars proposal.
required_followup: If execution is verified, seek event-specific accommodation/arrests/beatings/dispersal/ignore/killings/shootings evidence.

description: Proposal is described as opposing the national regime, but the original anonymous letter and exact demand remain unavailable.
required_followup: Recover original document and distinguish peaceful domestic-policy demands from armed action or exclusively electoral support.

description: Whether the January 19 proposal was related to the cancelled January 9 call is unresolved; shared political context alone does not merge them.
required_followup: Compare original calls, organization and actual occurrence; retain separate cancellation record.

description: December 2020 and February 2021 boundaries were searched. No physical episode beginning earlier and continuing in January was established; this is not evidence none existed.
required_followup: Inspect adjacent-month original archives; log continuations only with actual physical-episode evidence.

description: Four actual queries used malformed site. syntax; corrected site: queries were then executed. Even corrected path/country/date filters produced irrelevant countries, years, sports and cultural content.
required_followup: Use body dates and venues; preserve failed queries without treating results as chronological coverage.

description: Investment climate, annual rights reports and indexed snippets offer background rather than a complete contemporary protest archive. The Radio Macuto impasse HTTPS page yielded no selected article paragraphs.
required_followup: Locate equivalent dated news archives and verify article bodies before coding.

description: Country code 411 and queue universe are provisional; latest official baseline and additional Coding Procedure remain pending.
required_followup: Coordinator must reconcile current official files, schema and episode rules before any official export.

description: Search year and edition labels differ from action dates: the Freedom House 2021 report covers 2020; taxi strike is May 2017; PDGE January page has historical adjacent chronology.
required_followup: Confirm original publication metadata and avoid transferring old events into this month.
